scenarios.prompt: A quest step can be accepted, completed, turned in, failed or abandoned. Define idempotent transitions and recovery paths.

criteria.lifecycle: Beat states and transitions are explicit and idempotent.
criteria.recovery: Destructive/failure transitions name retry/fail-forward/abandon or intentional permanence.
criteria.evidence: Reload and duplicate-event tests preserve state and rewards.
